area: Soliton lens stand-in, the impactors, Prism and the Meerkat kit's sentinels
summary: Meerkat wormhole revisit (Yash, 2026-11-20): (1) the march-free lens stand-in (#1877) now stays on while riding, because the tube the eye is inside draws no wall in either variant (a new throat effect draws it); (2) Prism gains SetSealed/IsSealed (collider off, Damage/Consume/Gnaw/Vanish/Steal ignored) used only for prisms a Soliton Tunnel carries; (3) ExplosionImpactor, ProjectileImpactor, MineImpactor, SkimmerImpactor, VesselImpactor and the two crystal impactors each ask SolitonIsolation one question, so a hull or cargo inside a tube and anything outside it do not interact; (4) a sentinel no longer picks a rival that is riding a tube. All are no-ops in a match with no Meerkat.
